evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep said 'Let me go ahead and create a profile for you so I can get the details of your move and I can provide you an accurate code you can depend on' — no time-box framing (10-15 min) and no wait for a yes before proceeding into discovery.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Nicole asked 'do you have any specific concern or stresser about the moving process in general?' — this came after extensive logistics probing had already started (property type, stories, parking, square footage, bedrooms, appliances, storage unit details).
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type: townhome/house; stories: single-story both; rooms: 1 bedroom + 1 office; parking: driveway and street; storage: outdoor unit with dining set, chairs, china cabinet, wing chair; appliances: washer/dryer; total square footage 1000 sq ft (current home).
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Nicole provided range 'four to six hours' and personalization: 'in your case since you're moving from a one story town home with few items from a storage unit...I will estimate this move to take around five to six hours' with total estimate '$1,115 to $1,323 which includes the travel fee.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Disclosed hourly rate ($208/hr for 2 movers), trip fee ($75), included items (fuel, insurance, pads, tools), minimum (2.5 hours), per-rated in 15-minute increments. Said 'no hidden fees of any type' and disclosed travel fee upfront.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Nicole moved directly to 'To secure a spot there's no deposit record' without asking 'Does that feel fair?' or any validation check.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Fully delivered: 'if we cannot make it in the time window that we arrange we immediately start discounting money of your final bill and the way the clock works is the time start as soon as we get on site.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Fully delivered: 'we have no worries, damage coverage we provide up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for any accidental damages' — though no explicit 'no deductible / no fine print' framing added, the $2,000 coverage and repair/replace/reimburse language is clear.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No — rep did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar, and moved directly into deposit/booking language.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Nicole asked 'do you have any questions or anything for me?' at the end — this is a throwaway, not a genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' version.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Full: 'would you like our help with your move?' — asked plainly without a built-in out. Customer said 'Yeah, let's go ahead and book it.'
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Mentioned as part of deposit language: 'there's no deposit record, if you have to reschedule, or cancel no fees for that either' — rate lock itself not explicitly stated, but no-deposit and no-cancellation-fees were covered.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial — Date confirmed (Tuesday September 29th, 8:30 AM arrival); phone number confirmed (512-999-2362); arrival window confirmed (8:30 AM to 9:00 AM, 30-minute window); crew size stated as 2 movers and 1 truck throughout. Addresses: from-address confirmed in detail; to-address confirmed in detail. However, storage-unit address NOT yet confirmed (rep acknowledged 'I don't have the complete address yet for the storage unit' and said it would be updated after customer email response). No explicit crew notes about customer's concerns left with the booking (customer had no concerns raised, so this may not apply, but it is part of the standard confirmation checklist).

top_strength: Comprehensive logistics discovery — Nicole systematically gathered property type, stories, parking, square footage, bedrooms, appliances, and storage-unit details, and provided a personalized time and price estimate with full fee transparency upfront.
coaching_note: Add the time-boxed quid pro quo framing (10–15 minutes + dependable quote + wait for yes) at the very start of Section 1, and ask 'Does that feel fair?' with a genuine pause before moving into booking — both are high-leverage moments you're skipping now.
